title: Particle Cosmology
summary: Particle cosmology is the branch of science that seeks to understand the birth and evolution of the Universe by applying the principles of particle physics. It brings together the physics of the very small (fundamental particles and forces) with the physics of the very large (the structure and evolution of the cosmos). In many ways, the early Universe acts as a natural laboratory - one far more energetic than any collider we can build - offering unique insights into phenomena that may never be accessible on Earth.
